nodes.label: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic RL
nodes.author: Zhenyu Hou, Yujiang Li, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong
nodes.rationale: Addresses training stability and off-policy challenges in asynchronous RL for LLMs by replacing group-wise sampling with single-rollout sampling and introducing token-level importance sampling with double-sided clipping.

nodes.label: Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO)
nodes.rationale: Core method replacing group-wise sampling with single-rollout updates to reduce off-policy effects and improve stability in asynchronous RL training.

nodes.label: Direct Double-Sided Importance Sampling (DIS)
nodes.rationale: Stabilizes asynchronous RL by using rollout log-probabilities directly and applying double-sided token-level clipping to prevent instabilities from extreme policy divergence.

nodes.label: Value Model Training Strategies
nodes.rationale: Includes faster value updates than policy, frozen-attention training, and skip-observation token-level GAE to reduce variance and stabilize single-rollout RL.

nodes.label: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
nodes.rationale: Baseline method using group-wise sampling that introduces latency-driven off-policy behavior; SAO replaces this with single-rollout sampling.

nodes.label: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
nodes.rationale: Standard actor-critic RL algorithm using separate value function; SAO adapts this for asynchronous single-rollout settings.

nodes.label: Agentic RL Benchmarks (SWE-Bench, AIME, BeyondAIME, HMMT, IMOAnswerBench)
nodes.rationale: Evaluation benchmarks for coding and reasoning tasks demonstrating SAO's effectiveness.

nodes.label: GLM-5.2 Model (750B-A40B)
nodes.rationale: Large-scale model successfully trained using SAO in agentic RL pipeline.
